name: lsp-relay
description: Exposes VS Code language server capabilities via a local HTTP API for LLM agents

semcode.port.markdownDescription:
Port for the LSP Relay HTTP server.

- `0` (default): OS assigns a random available port. The actual port is written to `~/.semcode/ports/<workspace>/port.json`.
- Any other value (e.g. `4238`): The extension binds to that specific port. Use a fixed port when configuring Claude Code HTTP hooks so the URL is predictable without a shell command.

**Restart VS Code** after changing this setting.

scripts.install:ext: npm run build && npm run package && code --uninstall-extension local.lsp-relay && code --install-extension `pwd`/lsp-relay.vsix --force
